summary: CR-385 Phase 1 QA (Role 4) RE-RUN executed end-to-end successfully. All Modify/Cancel/No-Show/M7 acceptance cases now PASS against the Late chip (business date 2026-09-22). Confirmed the previously-reported radio-testability regression is FIXED: page.click on [data-testid=radio-extend-rate-mode-held] flips the DOM `checked` to true, status flips to 'Unsaved changes', Save enables. All three seed bookings 225/226/227 cancelled by end of run (200/200/200). Late chip 13 → 12 → 11 → 10 as expected. Front Desk Rules ends at defaults (early=false, calendar) verified by reload. Legacy BUG-441 reproduced: POST .../local-reservations/MG-69-DD9A2965-CACC-454B-903A-0919C9F644C8/cancel → 500 (string bookingId used as {id} path segment). No new blockers found.

minor.issue: AiosellController::cancelLocalReservation returns 500 on non-int {id}; should validate and return 400/404. Optional hardening.
